roleContext.jobDescription: We run 310 quick-service restaurants and a central kitchen that supplies them every morning. The Demand Forecasting Data Scientist is responsible for the daily item-level sales forecasts that drive kitchen production and restaurant ordering, measures forecast accuracy with the supply team, explains forecast changes to restaurant operations and keeps the forecasting code tested and documented. The forecasts set food-waste and availability targets, so the role asks for professional accreditation in statistics, such as Chartered Statistician status. The data scientist joins a small analytics team of three and works closely with the supply planners, the central kitchen manager and the area operations managers.

requirements.text: Builds daily item-level sales forecasts for restaurants or stores using statistical or machine learning models.
Holds Chartered Statistician (CStat) status or an equivalent professional accreditation in statistics.
Measures forecast accuracy with the supply team using agreed error metrics.
Explains forecast changes to operations managers in plain language.
Keeps forecasting code tested, documented and under version control.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Demand Forecasting Data Scientist

## Experience

- Data Scientist, Burrow & Bean Coffee (April 2022 to August 2026): built daily item-level forecasts for 140 coffee shops with gradient-boosted models on sales history, weather and local events, feeding the bakery production plan; the forecasting code was kept in the team's Git repository.
- Agreed weighted MAPE and bias by item family as the accuracy measures with the supply planning team and reported them every Monday.
- Chartered Statistician (CStat), Royal Statistical Society, awarded July 2023.
- Ran a monthly session with area managers explaining large forecast changes, such as the effect of school holidays and new menu items, without statistical jargon.
- Statistician, Wyke County Council (August 2019 to March 2022): produced small-area population estimates and documented the methods for the council's planning team.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised Monday accuracy report showing weighted MAPE and bias by item family for one month, with the forecast-versus-actual chart for pastries and notes on two promotional weeks.
